The rear bumper cover is cracked and displaced, with the trunk lid edge and both tail
lamp assemblies showing impact deformation consistent with a straight rear strike.

the estimate are reasonable for this scope of repair, and the line items show no
duplicated charges. Nothing observed suggests earlier damage to this vehicle. Proposed
plan: replace the bumper cover, both tail lamps, and the trunk lid edge trim, repair
the quarter panel, and perform a rear alignment check before refinishing.
